A '''baked potato''' is a cooked [[potato]]. It heals {{Hp|5}}, more than any other simple preparation, and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_potato.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Potatoes cook into baked potatoes in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. The vanilla smelting, smoking and campfire recipes are replaced. In a [[mud kiln]], a potato becomes a [[charred potato]] instead.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a baked potato takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|5}}.

Obtaining a baked potato unlocks [[pickled potatoes]], [[latke]]s and [[fish and chips]]; it is also used in [[gnocchi]].
